# PilotDesk

PilotDesk provides free browser-based aviation calculators, pilot math references, airport weather tools, flight-planning tools, aircraft profiles, and training aids.

## Primary pages
- https://www.pilot-desk.com/ — aviation calculators
- https://www.pilot-desk.com/planner.html — pilot flight planner
- https://www.pilot-desk.com/weather.html — aviation weather, METAR and TAF
- https://www.pilot-desk.com/metar-decoder.html — METAR decoder
- https://www.pilot-desk.com/airport.html — airport search and FAA procedure links
- https://www.pilot-desk.com/guides.html — aviation guides
- https://www.pilot-desk.com/guides/pilot-math-formulas.html — pilot math formula reference
- https://www.pilot-desk.com/guides/aviation-math-glossary.html — aviation math glossary
- https://www.pilot-desk.com/sources.html — sources and methods

## Notes
PilotDesk is a supplemental planning and training aid. Operational decisions should be verified against current approved aircraft data, official weather, regulations, procedures, NOTAMs, and other applicable authoritative sources.
